name: ssh-keygen
description: Generates, manages and converts authentication keys for ssh

options.name: -A
options.description: For each of the key types (rsa, dsa, ecdsa and ed25519) for which host keys do not exist, generate the host keys with the default key file path, an empty passphrase, default bits for the key type, and default comment

options.name: -a
options.description: When saving a private key, this option specifies the number of KDF

options.name: -B
options.description: Show the bubblebabble digest of specified private or public key file

options.name: -b
options.description: Specifies the number of bits in the key to create

args.name: bits
args.description: Number of bits in the key

options.name: -C
options.description: Provides a new comment

options.name: -c
options.description: Requests changing the comment in the private and public key files

options.name: -D
options.description: Download the public keys provided by the PKCS#11

options.name: -E
options.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used

options.name: -e
options.description: Read a OpenSSH key file and print to stdout

options.name: -F
options.description: Search for the specified hostname (with optional port number)

options.name: -f
options.description: Specifies the filename of the key file

options.name: -g
options.description: Use generic DNS format when printing fingerprint resource records

options.name: -H
options.description: Hash a known_hosts file

options.name: -h
options.description: Create a host certificate instead of a user

options.name: -I
options.description: Specify the key identity when signing a public key

options.name: -i
options.description: Read an unencrypted private (or public) key file

options.name: -K
options.description: Download resident keys from a FIDO authenticator

options.name: -k
options.description: Generate a KRL file

options.name: -L
options.description: Generate a KRL file

options.name: -l
options.description: Show fingerprint of specified public key file

options.name: -M
options.description: Use for Moduli generation

options.name: -m
options.description: Specify a key format for key generation

options.name: -N
options.description: Provides the new passphrase

options.name: -n
options.description: Specify one or more principals (user or host names) to be included in a certificate when signing a key

args.name: principals
args.description: Principals to be included in a certificate when signing a key

options.name: -O
options.description: Specify a key/value option

options.name: -P
options.description: Provides the (old) passphrase

options.name: -p
options.description: Requests changing the passphrase of a private key file instead of creating a new private key

options.name: -Q
options.description: Test whether keys have been revoked in a KRL

options.name: -q
options.description: Silence ssh-keygen

options.name: -R
options.description: Removes all keys belonging to hostname

args.name: hostname
args.description: Hostname to remove keys from a known_hosts file

options.name: -r
options.description: Print the SSHFP fingerprint resource record named hostname for the specified public key file

args.name: hostname
args.description: Hostname for the specified public key file

options.name: -s
options.description: Certify (sign) a public key using the specified CA key

args.name: ca_key
args.description: Hostname for the specified public key file

options.name: -t
options.description: Specifies the type of key to create

options.name: -U
options.description: When used in combination with -s, this option indicates that a CA key resides in a ssh-agent(1)

options.name: -u
options.description: Update a KRL

options.name: -V
options.description: Specify a validity interval when signing a certificate

options.name: -v
options.description: Verbose mode

options.name: -w
options.description: Specifies a path to a library that will be used when creating FIDO authenticator-hosted keys

args.name: provider
args.description: Path to library to be used when creating FIDO authenticator-hosted keys

options.name: -Y
options.description: Multiple functions: find principals, match principals, check novalidate, sign, verify

suggestions.name: find-principals
suggestions.description: Find the principal(s) associated with the public key of a signature

suggestions.name: check-novalidate
suggestions.description: Checks that a signature generated using ssh-keygen -Y sign has a valid structure

suggestions.name: sign
suggestions.description: Cryptographically sign a file or some data using a SSH key

suggestions.name: verify
suggestions.description: Request to verify a signature generated using ssh-keygen -Y

options.name: -y
options.description: Read a private OpenSSH format file and print an OpenSSH public key to stdout

options.name: -Z
options.description: Specifies the cipher to use for encryption when writing an OpenSSH-format private key file

options.name: -z
options.description: Specifies a serial number to be embedded in the certificate to distinguish this certificate from others from the same CA

args.name: serial_number
args.description: Serial number to distinguish this certificate
